title: Tender for fiduciary management services (detailed guidance)
note: Establishes: from 1 October 2022 trustees must run a qualifying tender (bids invited from at least three unconnected providers) before a fiduciary management appointment that takes the scheme to or over the threshold of 20% of manageable assets; duties replace those in the 2019 CMA order.

title: The Occupational Pension Schemes (Governance and Registration) (Amendment) Regulations 2022 (S.I. 2022/825), Explanatory Note
note: Establishes: trustees required to set objectives for persons providing investment consultancy services and to carry out a qualifying tender process for fiduciary management arrangements. The note itself does not state the 20% threshold or commencement date (see W3-S01).

title: PS22/9: A new Consumer Duty: Feedback to CP21/36 and final rules
note: Establishes commencement: 31 July 2023 for new and existing products or services open to sale or renewal; 31 July 2024 for closed products or services.

title: Consumer Duty: about the Duty
note: Establishes the Consumer Principle wording ('A firm must act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers') and the four outcomes. Page last updated 23 October 2026. Does not itself describe distribution-chain obligations.

title: FCA Handbook PRIN 2A.4 Consumer Duty: retail customer outcome on price and value
note: Search-result passage only (page not fetched): manufacturers must ensure products provide fair value to retail customers; a distributor must not distribute a product unless its distribution arrangements are consistent with the product providing fair value. Check wording on the Handbook before quoting.
